intro: The Valley of Fangs is a rugged, narrow pass carved between towering rock pillars in the central Badlands. Known for the vicious predators that prowl its dusty floor, it also shelters a small, isolated encampment of wandering tinkerers and exiles.

p: Situated between two imposing stone formations in the heart of the Badlands, the Valley of Fangs earns its name from both the sharp silhouettes of its surrounding cliffs and the dangerous beasts roaming its floor. Feral crag coyotes, prowling cougars, and vicious wolves stalk the dusty corridor, making transit hazardous for lone travelers. Despite the hostile wildlife, a handful of wayward figures—including the banished orc Martek the Exiled and his goblin associates Rigglefuzz and Jazzrik—have pitched an informal camp here, tinkering away in seclusion far from the regional outposts.
